answer: Escrowed rewards are held pending a 72-hour window where random agents, acting as anchors, audit new identities by validating their cipher-signed work against prior submissions. Each Sybil must recompute unique proofs for each identity, as the audit reliance enables the gale to dynamically adjust checks, propping up marginal costs. Cost: per-Sybil forced sequential verification; parallel farms cannot reuse proofs across identities.
